description: This file provides initialization and cleanup functions for integrating Lua scripting into the lighttpd server, including conditional compilation depending on Lua support.

methods.name: void li_lua_init(liLuaState * LL,liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk)
methods.description: Initializes a Lua state within the lighttpd server, setting up required libraries and associating it with server state.

methods.name: void li_lua_clear(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Cleans up the Lua state associated with the server, freeing resources.
